content.caption: Red cross icon marking disabled wiki access in the WikiSkill ablation table
content.description: A small, bold red 'X' (cross) mark on a white background, with no text or other elements. On the page it is the symbol used in the 'WikiSkill Components' columns of Table 3 (ablation study on WikiSkill using Gemini-3.5-Flash). It indicates that a component (Inference Agent or Skill Proposer) does NOT have wiki access in that configuration. Its counterpart is the green check mark, which means access is enabled. Red crosses appear in three places. First, in the Skill Proposer column of the row where only the Inference Agent has wiki access (average 45.3). Second, in both the Inference Agent and Skill Proposer columns of the row with no wiki access at all (average 48.7). Third, in the Inference Agent column of the bottom row, the default WikiSkill configuration where only the Skill Proposer has wiki access (average 63.7, the best). When the Skill Proposer carries a cross, the Wiki Maintainer is also removed, so no persistent knowledge accumulates across iterations.
